changelog: AI-Based Risk Zone Prediction Engine: Gradient Boosting model calibrated on regional crime data (97.2% Accuracy, F1 0.972)

Continuous Real-Time GPS Tracking: Live location tracking across SafeRoute, Explore radar, and Home telemetry pings
Instant In-App Updater: Live direct APK download and update stream
